request_create.label: Save Request
request_create.outcome: Saves a new request in Tutor Compass with the rule engine's result. Nothing is refunded, booked or sent.

request_send_to_owner.label: Send to Owner
request_send_to_owner.outcome: Moves the request to Waiting for Owner with your note. Nothing is sent to the family.

request_approve.label: Approve
request_approve.outcome: Records your decision as Approved by Owner. It does not move money, change a booking or contact the family.

request_decline.label: Decline
request_decline.outcome: Records your decision as Declined by Owner. Nothing is sent to the family.

request_request_info.label: Ask for Information
request_request_info.outcome: Sends the request back to the admin team with your questions. Nothing is sent to the family.

request_record_outcome.label: Record Outcome
request_record_outcome.outcome: Records what was done and closes the request. Tutor Compass does not carry out the action itself.

draft_save.label: Save Draft
draft_save.outcome: Saves the draft on the request so others can see it. It is not sent to anyone.

booking_reschedule.label: Move Lesson
booking_reschedule.outcome: Moves the lesson on Tutor Compass's timetable and closes the request. Nothing is sent to the family or the tutor.

invoice_extend_due_date.label: Extend Due Date
invoice_extend_due_date.outcome: Changes the due date on Tutor Compass's record of the invoice, replaces its reminder schedule and closes the request. No payment system is connected and no reminder is sent.

tutor_record_absence.label: Record Absence
tutor_record_absence.outcome: Records the tutor as away for these dates, so Compass stops offering their times. It doesn't move any lesson by itself.
